notes.title: 0.07: Playtest feedback & bugfix bonaza
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Many thanks to all who have checked out the playtest — there have now been over 1500 of you, which is very cool. The game has received a ton of useful feedback on Discord, Reddit, and here on Steam, which has been incredibly helpful. I have broadly split this feedback into 'gameplay' and 'story'. This update specifically targets the 'gameplay' side of things, with a 'story' update coming soon. Here's a list of changes that have made their way in:

 0.07 Release Notes  Added billing breakdown window that provides a per-second breakdown of income and outgoings. Makes it much easier to figure out cause & effect. Improved 'Impact Prediction'. This is now its own window, and provides full estimates how upgrades will impact usage. Hovering over graphs in the monitor increases their size and provides more stats. Reworked harvesting system. Data is now harvested into dataset form, after which it can be processed as normal. Reworked cluster computing upgrade so it's 1/10th as powerful but also 1/10th the price. Reduces grind. Viruses now delete one random piece of software. Increases peril. Add options menu with volume control, windowed mode settings, and experimental font size scaling feature, and option to switch temperature measurement from F to C. Memory used now has much less impact on processing power used, as this made little sense. Processing power from clicks per second has been boosted to offset the above change. Ensure antivirus and firewall make viruses and disconnections impossible at max level (instead of just very unlikely). Fix issue where clicking windows would often drag other random windows to the front, too.  Smaller changes & bugfixes:  Hopefully fix Steam game ID issue. Reworked CO2 figures to be higher. Improve email readout queue system. Electricity generators now use more emissions than they did before. Fix bug where downgrading often broke temperature. Fix last cluster computing node from disconnecting multiple times. Fix camera naming error. Fix impact prediction for cameras. Fix misc. audio bugs. Ensure marketplace greys out items that aren't purchasable. Stop payments from being deducted during tutorial. Fix bug where total cameras count was inaccurate. Fix MP3 player dragging issue.

notes.title: 0.04 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Little patch that does a few things.

- FINALLY pinned down the rendering bug where aliasing would look off (overly sharp and hard to read) on larger screens. Expect a smoother, more luxurious eyefeel from here on out.
- Fixed bug that appeared in the previous update where the game would always be in easy mode, regardless of what difficulty was picked. My apologies for this one.
- Misc small style tweaks.

Thank you for playtesting.

notes.title: 0.031 Patch
notes.notes: Minor release patching some reported bugs from the previous update.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Version 0.03
notes.notes:
New update! Has been a second, but this has some relatively chunky stuff in. Some of it is still pretty experimental and/or in progress, so expect some rough edges!

Changes:

— New virus (/antivirus) mechanic
— New Cluster Computing ‘minigame’; nodes can be come disconnected and need reconnecting.
— Big upgrade & rewrite of the FACEMINER Administration emails, for which I am entirely indebted to Invotek. A very large thank you.
— Reworked 'Impact Prediction' so it uses numbers instead of showing up on the graphs. Hopefully this is a little more usable (though still ironing out the last few glitches here)
— Balance tweaks around cameras & emissions
— Many misc small UI/UX bits
— Many of the reported bugs in the feedback channel on Discord

notes.title: Launching: FACEMINER Full Game Pre-Alpha Version 0.02
notes.notes:
Hello,
The Full Game Pre-Alpha Version 0.02 of FACEMINER is now available to download as a Playtest. Expect spoilers, bugs, and plenty of placeholder text -- but also a completable, end-to-end experience. As always, any feedback and bug reports are very welcome in Discord & on the Steam Forums. Thank you for following the game!
